events.description: Canonical set projection of covered Events. Every item carries the canonical Event ID, whose 33-octet token losslessly encodes the suite and full digest, plus the verified Event kind. Items MUST be strictly increasing by the UTF-8 bytes of canonical_json(item); producers sort and deduplicate before signing, and receivers reject a non-canonical wire array before digest verification.

proofs.description: Detached receipt proofs sign canonical_json({context:'ak.receipt_proof.v1', payload_digest: receipt_digest, issuer, verification_method, created_at, domain?, audience?}); context is a fixed signing-context domain tag, not a wire field.

allOf.$comment: A PCR genesis receipt is a canonical set containing exactly one realm create and one founding device authorize item. Array position has no domain meaning.

A device re-anchor receipt is a canonical set containing exactly one reanchor and one replacement authorize item. Each typed item carries the canonical Event ID, from which its suite-bearing digest is derived; array position has no domain meaning.

device_reanchor_scope.description: Durable acceptance evidence for an account-local PCR-policy re-anchor unit. The authority pair plus monotonic device generation selects the create-once lineage maintained by the Station.

account_id.description: Exact AccountId of the covered re-anchor Event. Both components MUST match the payload and the accepting Station MUST equal account_id.station_id.

previous_device_generation.description: MUST equal the covered ak.device.reanchor payload previous_device_generation.

new_device_generation.description: Accepted monotonic successor generation. It MUST equal the covered ak.device.reanchor payload new_device_generation and MUST be the immediate successor of previous_device_generation. It is a PCR-local ref and MUST NOT be derived from or rendered as a DID versionId.

pcr_genesis_scope.description: Durable acceptance evidence for the create-once PCR genesis unit. The covered typed Event IDs are calculated only after both Events are fully formed and never enter either Event preimage.

did_version_id.description: The exact method-native version identifier pinned by the identity-root control proof. It identifies verified DID control evidence and MUST NOT initialize or otherwise determine the PCR-local device generation.

log_head_digest.description: The exact verified DID history head digest accepted for this PCR genesis. It is a cross-Realm identity-root commitment and is always SHA-256.

control_key_digest.description: SHA-256(UTF-8(canonical multikey)) of the active identity-root control key pinned by the control proof; see zh/identity/account-lifecycle.md section 2.1.

registration_evidence_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of RFC 8785 JCS of the complete accepted registration_did_evidence relayed to the Station.

device_key_digest.description: SHA-256(UTF-8(canonical multikey)) where the preimage is the accepted founding device_public_key_did with its did:key: prefix removed (the bare z6Mk... multikey string). The receipt carries no raw key, so the Station computes it from the accepted genesis descriptor with the same encoding discipline as control_key_digest. Hashing the complete did:key: URI, the decoded key octets or any other suite is founding_device_commitment_mismatch.

hpke_key_digest.description: SHA-256(UTF-8(canonical multikey)) where the preimage is the accepted founding hpke_key exactly as carried (the canonical X25519 multikey string starting with z6LS). Same encoding discipline as device_key_digest and control_key_digest; never the Realm digest_algorithm.
